body:
So, the great spiritual migration we need cannot simply be a matter of strategies and structures, as important as they are. Rather, as Pope Francis has said, this moment calls for social poets: sincere and creative people who will rise on the wings of faith to catch the wind of the Spirit, the wind of justice, joy, and peace. The season is changing, and it is time for us to rise.

 – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016)
